atom_reviews.question: Are there any rabbits in the image?

All taxonomy checkpoints for biological hare (elongated body, black-tipped ears, muscular hind limbs) are absent. However, strict taxonomic conformance to class 'hare' is very low due to complete absence of diagnostic anatomical features. Tax score reflects this mismatch between generated object type and provided biological taxonomy.

authenticity_review: Image demonstrates strong photorealism in lighting, depth-of-field blur, and fabric texture rendering. Minor AI artifacts persist: whiskers appear as thin floating lines not convincingly anchored to fabric surface; some front paws show slight blending into wooden table without crisp contact shadows. These are subtle generation flaws but do not undermine overall visual coherence.

Taxonomy mismatch: Plush toy form lacks all biological hare diagnostics (elongated torso, black-tipped ears, powerful hind limbs)
